content:
Jordan L: Ivy wants a Private POC with BYOK + cert handoff. They asked for a minimal artifact list and timeline (48h). Can we meet it?

Amy S: We can. Two routes: (A) Customer-managed KMS (recommended), or (B) Redwood-managed temporary key (fast).

Priya N: For Customer KMS we need: KMS key ARN with our service principal in the key policy, VPC/subnet info, CA-signed agent cert (PEM). If they use HSM, request a wrapped key blob and attestation.

Victor H: Quick copy-paste CSR for them to run:
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out agent.key
openssl req -new -key agent.key -out agent.csr -subj "/CN=redwood-agent.ivy.poc/O=Ivy"

Amy S: Minimal JSON we ask them to paste (literal):
{ "customer":"Ivy","vpc_id":"vpc-0abcd","subnets":["subnet-1","subnet-2"],"kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd","agent_cert_pem":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----...","key_mode":"BYOK" }

Priya N: Networking note: agent needs outbound to api.redwood-inference.internal:443 and access to model storage. If egress is locked down, provide proxy details or we deploy an outbound relay in their VPC.

Victor H: Validation flow we run after they send artifacts: 1) Check KMS policy access, 2) Upload cert bundle, 3) Agent bootstrap, 4) Run encrypt/decrypt and cert-signature verify.

Amy S: If they accept Redwood-managed keys, require a short custody addendum and we can often launch in <24h. I'll send the opt-in form and a pricing ballpark to Jordan.

infra_bot: Onboarding ticket created: https://internal.redwood/onboard/1987654321

Jordan L: Cool. Amy please send forms; Victor/Priya drop the validation script link and I'll confirm the 48h window with Ivy.

Amy S: Will do in ~20m.

Victor H: I'll paste the validation script link here once it's gisted.

Priya N: I'll prepare the security blurb (rotation cadence, escrow, attestation) for the questionnaire and tag legal.

Jordan L: Thanks team.
